diff --git a/devinfra/buildbuddy/ci/remote_log.sh b/devinfra/buildbuddy/ci/remote_log.sh

@@ -30,6 +30,10 @@ bb_remote_with_log() {

+  if ((status != 0)); then
+    python3 "$cancel_script" "${INPUT_BAZEL_INVOCATION_IDS:-}" \
+      || echo "bb-remote: failed to request child cancellation after command failure" >&2
+  fi

The older run controller is asynchronous and runner-queued; this guard can avoid stale-run setup and remote demand while preserving the latest run’s existing per-run admission.

import hashlib

import pytest
import pytest_bazel
from playwright.async_api import expect
from python.runfiles import Runfiles

from util.testing.frontend_visual.capture import VisualHarness
from util.testing.frontend_visual.viewports import Viewport

pytest_plugins = ("util.testing.frontend_visual.fixtures",)
pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio(loop_scope="session")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("viewport", [Viewport(1280, 900), Viewport(390, 844)], ids=["desktop", "mobile"])
async def test_report(visual: VisualHarness, viewport: Viewport) -> None:
    root = Runfiles.CreateOrRaise().root() / "ducktape/x/ci_latency_preview"
    async with visual.open(viewport=viewport) as view:
        await expect(view.page.locator("h1")).to_be_visible()
        anchors = await view.page.locator('a[href^="#"]').evaluate_all("links => links.map(a => a.hash.slice(1))")
        for anchor in anchors:
            assert await view.page.locator(f'[id="{anchor}"]').count() == 1
        await view.capture("first-screen")
        for section in ("feedback", "system-tests", "experiments", "options"):
            await view.page.locator(f"#{section}").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            await view.capture(section)
        selector = view.page.locator("#trace-select")
        for index in range(await selector.locator("option").count()):
            await selector.select_option(str(index))
            chart = view.page.locator(f"#trace-{index}")
            await expect(chart).to_be_visible()
            await view.capture(f"phase-trace-{index}", target=chart)
        details = view.page.locator("details")
        for i in range(await details.count()):
            await details.nth(i).locator("summary").click()
        assert await view.page.evaluate((root / "layout.js").read_text()) == []
        view.outputs.publish(
            role="diagnostics",
            suffix="txt",
            data="report_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256((root / "index.html").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest_bazel.main()
